about: [C12 critic] II by the pad: walking in on the stick a little off straight (33 deg, then 24 deg, then pulled back half): does the stick hop me aside / back when I only meant to walk?

steps.eval: (window.__hops = [], window.__ha = 0, setInterval(() => { const m = G.brawl.me; if (m && m.lastHop !== window.__ha) { window.__ha = m.lastHop; window.__hops.push([+N.time.toFixed(1), m.lastHopKey]); } }, 30), 1)
({ hops33: window.__hops.slice(), d: +Math.hypot(G.brawl.c.pos.x - G.eye.x, G.brawl.c.pos.z - G.eye.z).toFixed(2) })
